dedupe_keys.name: a comprehensive hyperspectral image dataset for forest fire detection and classification

description: A Comprehensive Hyperspectral Image Dataset for Forest Fire Detection and Classification is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ashish Mani et al. In this paper we introduce a new large-scale hyperspectral satellite image dataset named OHID-FF, specifically designed for forest fire detection and classification tasks. The OHID-FF dataset comprises 1,197 hyperspectral images from 22 different scenarios, with each image featuring 32 spectral bands and a spatial resolution of 10 meters per pixel. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: TXT, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2093597353 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
